interpretation: All three seeds for both 300-update answers-only settings have native evaluations. Rank 16 scores 41, 45 and 45 percent validation accuracy; rank 32 scores 42, 40 and 41 percent, against 41 percent untuned. Neither paired interval establishes improvement. Two reasoning seeds score 50 and 53 percent but fail promotion gates. One short-budget reasoning seed and twelve longer-budget conditions remain unevaluated locally; current Sol queue cannot be verified during the SSH timeout.

referenceFormatDiagnostic.limitations: Post-hoc six-case likelihood probe, not free generation or native accuracy. Neither mode establishes the cause of the native score gap.

baselineRuntimeAgreement.limitation: One development baseline model and one pass per runtime. This diagnoses agreement, not a general platform or worker-count effect. Mac latency may overlap other local inference.

localCollectors.behavior: Read the isolated study only, verify plan and model digests, preserve completed evidence, evaluate every candidate on the Mac, and regenerate the paired report. Long-budget collection waits for all nine short-budget native evaluations.
